column1: # Inomrah's Mythic Instructions — profile, one instruction per line
# Fill in column A only. Select column A, copy, paste into Settings > Profile > Import.
# A line starting Dungeon:, Channel:, Color: or Enemy: is an instruction.
# Every other line is a callout for the enemy above it.
Dangerous: [Ravenous Descendant] Attack speed +10% with each melee attack. Help tank by CC from time to time. I will kite out to not die.
[Venom Leech]: Move out of pools on ground.
Priority kick: [Serpent] <Piercing hiss> - Kick or we lose a lot of dps!
If you have a focus kick macro, please set your focus to one of the [Primal Serpent]. My color is Purple
[Twinfang Harrower]: (Paralyzing Shots): Healer magic dispel or use slow removal. Watch out for poison spin.
Use freedom effects to remove Paralyzing shots.
[Ritual Chieftain]: <Blood Sacrifice> Big 5 player healing absorb. 1. Use personal heal ability or 2. (Emergency): Use health pot.
Priority mob: [High Evolutionist]: Kick <Envenom> or dispel poison
We have to CC (stun, para, displace, poly etc) <Evolve> or it starts poisoning everyone. Focus kill if evolved!
Walking on eggs spawns [Hatchlings]. Not dangerous --> stand together for aoe.
Please don't walk over the eggs. [Hatchlings] give 0% count.
Avoid Blood pools on the ground
1. Avoid circles on ground and poison attacks. I will tank her next to the empty pile. Meat pile = bad time.
2. Soak (stand in) the green circles when she eats. <Ssssscavenging>
3. <Triple Shot>: Use defensive (OR Warrior: Spell reflect)
